method.baseline: Associated saved baseline_summary.json ROI mean_v, mean across baseline pixels and frames; three captures reused across 54 recordings
method.corrected: V - V0, signed camera V levels; no clipping
method.normalized: 100 * (V - V0) / V0, percent change relative to the associated saved baseline
method.weight: 1/n_s per frame, equal total weight for each of six recordings per taxel
method.fit: signal_hat = intercept + slope * aligned reference force; weighted least squares with intercept
method.r2: 1 - weighted SSE / weighted signal variance = weighted Pearson r squared; descriptive in-sample association
method.scope_limits: Same 7154 points and alignment as raw-V analysis; no force-informed normalization, smoothing, filtering, retuning or model refit
method.invariance: Within a recording, subtraction and positive scaling preserve Pearson r and intercept-fit R2; V/V0 and percent relative change also have identical r and R2
